title: Shiv ji ki Jataon mein Ganga
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Ganga ko Shiv ji ne kyun roka?

scenes.prompt: A huge roaring river of heavenly light falling from the sky towards the earth, Lord Shiva standing calmly on a Himalayan peak with arms open to receive it, matted hair flowing, crescent moon on his head, blue-throated, serpent around neck, dramatic clouds
scenes.tts: स्वर्ग से गंगा जी का तेज़ प्रवाह उतर रहा था। कौन उन्हें थामेगा?
scenes.sub: Swarg se Ganga ji ka tez pravah utar raha tha. Kaun unhe thaamega?

scenes.prompt: King Bhagirath doing deep penance on a mountain with folded hands, thin and peaceful, forest and river around, soft golden light, ancient sages in the distance
scenes.tts: राजा भगीरथ ने अपने पूर्वजों के उद्धार के लिए कठोर तपस्या की।
scenes.sub: Raja Bhagirath ne apne purvajon ke uddhar ke liye kathor tapasya ki.

scenes.prompt: King Bhagirath kneeling in prayer before Lord Shiva on Mount Kailash, Shiva with matted locks, trident, crescent moon, serene compassionate face, snowy peaks
scenes.tts: गंगा जी का वेग धरती नहीं सह सकती थी, तब भगीरथ ने महादेव की आराधना की।
scenes.sub: Ganga ji ka veg dharti nahi sah sakti thi, tab Bhagirath ne Mahadev ki aradhana ki.

scenes.prompt: Lord Shiva standing on a Himalayan peak as the mighty Ganga falls from the heavens and gently flows into his matted locks, the river becoming calm streams of light, gods showering flowers from the sky
scenes.tts: गंगा जी शिव जी की जटाओं में समा गईं, और उनका वेग शांत हो गया।
scenes.sub: Ganga ji Shiv ji ki jataon mein sama gayi, aur unka veg shaant ho gaya.

scenes.prompt: Gentle sacred Ganga flowing down from the Himalayas to the plains, King Bhagirath walking ahead leading the river, blessed green land, soft sunrise glow
scenes.tts: फिर शिव जी ने उन्हें धीरे से छोड़ा, और भगीरथ के पीछे गंगा धरती पर चलीं।
scenes.sub: Phir Shiv ji ne unhe dheere se chhoda, aur Bhagirath ke peeche Ganga dharti par chali.

scenes.tts: ॐ नमः शिवाय! कथा अच्छी लगी हो तो लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें।
scenes.sub: Om Namah Shivaya! Katha achhi lagi ho to Like, Share aur Subscribe karein · Shyam Premi SN
